purpose.summary: This program prints a customer list ('Stampa Clienti') by reading a CLIENTI indexed file, optionally filtering by customer type, GDO code, and agent, sorting results via a temporary file (TMP-CLIENTI) by company name, and producing either a formatted TXT report or a CSV file for Excel export.
purpose.domain: business/ERP — customer management (Italian small business context)

notable_features: AcuCOBOL GUI DISPLAY MESSAGE with title and icon parameters
78-level figurative constants for titles and page size
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR for three files (lineseq, tmp-clienti, clienti)
Dual output mode: formatted TXT report vs. CSV/Excel via separatore
LINKAGE SECTION with stampa-linkage copybook (subprogram interface)
File sort via intermediate sequential tmp-clienti file keyed on ragsoc
Italian-language identifiers and string literals throughout
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS; no COMP-3 usage
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1, consistent with Italian accented characters (e.g., 'Città', 'già'). The source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently. The .sl/.fd/.def copy file extensions and GUI DISPLAY MESSAGE syntax are strong AcuCOBOL indicators. The program is a subprogram called with a LINKAGE SECTION parameter block (stampa-linkage), not a standalone batch program.
